drafts.en:
Health Functional FoodVitamin B1 0.6mgVitamin B6 0.8mgVitamin D 5μgSelenium 25μgZinc 4.5mg2 times a day

메가벨셀렌효모플러스비타민B1,B6,D,아연Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Selenium · Zinc

Made by 동서바이오팜(주) 안성공장 · 2 times a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 0.6mg of Vitamin B1, 0.8mg of Vitamin B6, 5μg of Vitamin D, 25μg of Selenium, 4.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (2 tablets): 0.6mg Vitamin B1, 0.8mg Vitamin B6, 5μg Vitamin D, 25μg Selenium, 4.5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 동서바이오팜(주) 안성공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day2 tablets per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Vitamin B1 labelled (0.6mg / 2400mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (0.8mg / 2400mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (5μg / 2400mg), 80~180%
Selenium labelled (25μg / 2400mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (4.5mg / 2400mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 연갈색의 장방형 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
Storage 직사광선 및 고온다습한 장소를 피하여 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오. 제품의 개봉 후에는 흡습의 우려가 있으므로 반드시 뚜껑을 잘 닫아 보관하여 주십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Selenium · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
